O.outcome_detail: ability to engage in empathetic clinical communication

cells.quote: Students must practise to develop the ability to engage in empathetic dialogue.
cells.note: The study reports clinicians' perceptions and described teaching approaches, but provides no comparison group or measured effect.

O.outcome_detail: uncertainty about permitted and appropriate AI use

cells.quote: "From the students’ responses, it appears that many schools in Hong Kong do not have specific guidelines regarding the use of AI tools."
cells.note: The quoted finding is reported in the wiki entry, not in the supplied study text. The entry also states that many students were uncertain whether AI use was permitted and to what extent it was appropriate; no comparative effect or direction is reported.
